### Publications

- Quartier-la-Tente A. (2022), “Real-time detection of turning points: the contribution of asymmetric filters to turning-point detection”, *[13e Journées de Méthodologie Statistique](http://www.jms-insee.fr/2022/S27_2_ACTE_QUARTIERLATENTE_JMS2020.pdf){target="_blank"}* (French article).

- Quartier-la-Tente A. (2015), “To what extent does the integration of sub-sectoral information improve the quality of manufacturing production forecasting?”, Master’s thesis.
